_comment: Single source of truth for whether /counsellor-details/* is submitted to Google. Read by src/hooks/useCounselors.ts (the page's robots tag) and scripts/site-routes.mjs (the sitemap), so the two cannot disagree. Was off (Aug 2026) to get through the AdSense 'thin content' review; re-enabled Nov 2026 after AdSense approval. Profiles whose bio is under THIN_PROFILE_BIO_CHARS stay noindex and out of the sitemap either way.
